## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature / capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `perf`: Performance optimization
- [ ] `refactor`: Code restructuring with no behavior change
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `test`: New or updated tests

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] Code follows idiomatic Rust standards (no unwrap/expect in library code).
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` passes cleanly.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` passes with zero warnings.
- [ ] Unit and/or integration tests have been added.
- [ ] Documentation has been updated (README, CLI help text, ROADMAP if applicable).
